rules.title: Xcode 编译缓存（DerivedData）
rules.explanation: Xcode 编译时生成的中间文件和索引。
rules.consequence: 下次打开项目时重新编译和建索引，第一次会慢一些。

en.title: Xcode build data (DerivedData)
en.explanation: Intermediate build products and indexes Xcode creates while building.
en.consequence: Projects rebuild and reindex the next time they open; the first build is slower.

rules.title: 旧设备的调试符号（DeviceSupport）
rules.explanation: 每连接一个新系统版本的设备，Xcode 就会下载一份调试符号，旧版本会一直留着。
rules.consequence: 再连接对应版本的设备时会重新下载。

en.title: Debug symbols for old devices (DeviceSupport)
en.explanation: Xcode downloads debug symbols for every new system version of a connected device and keeps the old ones.
en.consequence: They download again when a device on that version is connected.

rules.title: SwiftUI 预览缓存
rules.explanation: Xcode 为 SwiftUI 预览构建的专用模拟环境。
rules.consequence: 下次打开预览时重新生成。

en.title: SwiftUI preview cache
en.explanation: The simulated environments Xcode builds for SwiftUI previews.
en.consequence: Rebuilt the next time a preview opens.

rules.title: Xcode 归档（Archives）
rules.explanation: 每次 Product › Archive 生成的发布包，里面有符号化崩溃日志所需的 dSYM。
rules.consequence: 已发布版本的崩溃日志将无法符号化，建议只删除不再维护的旧版本。

en.title: Xcode archives
en.explanation: The release builds made by Product › Archive, including the dSYMs needed to symbolicate crash logs.
en.consequence: Crash logs from released versions can no longer be symbolicated; delete only old versions you no longer support.

rules.title: 模拟器缓存
rules.explanation: iOS 模拟器的动态库缓存。
rules.consequence: 下次启动模拟器时重新生成，第一次会慢一些。

en.title: Simulator caches
en.explanation: Dynamic library caches of the iOS Simulator.
en.consequence: Rebuilt the next time a simulator starts; the first start is slower.

rules.title: 模拟器设备
rules.explanation: 每台模拟器的系统和装在里面的 App。直接删文件夹会让 Xcode 的设备列表出错。
rules.consequence: 用命令删除已不可用的模拟器（对应的系统版本已卸载）。

en.title: Simulator devices
en.explanation: Each simulator's system and the apps installed in it. Deleting the folders directly confuses Xcode's device list.
en.consequence: Deletes, with a command, the simulators that can no longer run (their system version was uninstalled).

rules.title: Swift Package Manager 缓存
rules.explanation: 下载过的 Swift 包仓库。
rules.consequence: 下次解析依赖时重新下载。

en.title: Swift Package Manager cache
en.explanation: Downloaded Swift package repositories.
en.consequence: Downloaded again the next time dependencies are resolved.

rules.title: CocoaPods 缓存
rules.explanation: 下载过的 Pod 源码和 Specs。
rules.consequence: 下次 pod install 时重新下载。

en.title: CocoaPods cache
en.explanation: Downloaded pod sources and specs.
en.consequence: Downloaded again on the next pod install.

rules.title: Carthage 缓存
rules.explanation: 下载过的 Carthage 依赖。
rules.consequence: 下次构建依赖时重新下载。

en.title: Carthage cache
en.explanation: Downloaded Carthage dependencies.
en.consequence: Downloaded again the next time dependencies are built.

rules.title: npm 缓存
rules.explanation: npm 下载过的包。
rules.consequence: 下次安装依赖时重新下载。

en.title: npm cache
en.explanation: Packages npm has downloaded.
en.consequence: Downloaded again the next time dependencies are installed.

rules.title: Yarn 缓存
rules.explanation: Yarn 下载过的包。
rules.consequence: 下次安装依赖时重新下载。

en.title: Yarn cache
en.explanation: Packages Yarn has downloaded.
en.consequence: Downloaded again the next time dependencies are installed.

rules.title: pnpm 包仓库
rules.explanation: pnpm 用硬链接把包共享给各个项目，直接删除并不能释放被项目引用的部分。
rules.consequence: 用命令清掉没有任何项目引用的包。

en.title: pnpm store
en.explanation: pnpm shares packages with projects through hard links, so deleting it does not free what projects still use.
en.consequence: Removes, with a command, the packages no project refers to.

rules.title: Bun 缓存
rules.explanation: Bun 下载过的包。
rules.consequence: 下次安装依赖时重新下载。

en.title: Bun cache
en.explanation: Packages Bun has downloaded.
en.consequence: Downloaded again the next time dependencies are installed.

rules.title: node-gyp 头文件缓存
rules.explanation: 编译 Node 原生模块用的头文件。
rules.consequence: 下次编译原生模块时重新下载。

en.title: node-gyp header cache
en.explanation: Headers used to compile native Node modules.
en.consequence: Downloaded again the next time a native module is compiled.

rules.title: pip 缓存
rules.explanation: pip 下载和编译过的 Python 包。
rules.consequence: 下次安装时重新下载。

en.title: pip cache
en.explanation: Python packages pip has downloaded and built.
en.consequence: Downloaded again on the next install.

rules.title: uv 缓存
rules.explanation: uv 下载过的 Python 包和解释器。
rules.consequence: 下次安装时重新下载。

en.title: uv cache
en.explanation: Python packages and interpreters uv has downloaded.
en.consequence: Downloaded again on the next install.

rules.title: Conda 包缓存
rules.explanation: Conda 下载过的安装包，环境里可能还在引用。
rules.consequence: 用命令清理未使用的包和安装包。

en.title: Conda package cache
en.explanation: Packages Conda has downloaded; environments may still refer to them.
en.consequence: Removes, with a command, unused packages and installers.

rules.title: Homebrew 下载缓存
rules.explanation: Homebrew 下载过的安装包。
rules.consequence: 重新安装或升级时重新下载。

en.title: Homebrew download cache
en.explanation: Installers Homebrew has downloaded.
en.consequence: Downloaded again on the next install or upgrade.

rules.title: Go 编译缓存
rules.explanation: go build 和 go test 的编译结果缓存。
rules.consequence: 下次编译会慢一些。

en.title: Go build cache
en.explanation: Cached results of go build and go test.
en.consequence: The next build is slower.

rules.title: Go 模块缓存
rules.explanation: 下载过的 Go 模块。文件是只读的，直接删除会遇到权限问题。
rules.consequence: 用命令清除，之后编译时重新下载。

en.title: Go module cache
en.explanation: Downloaded Go modules. The files are read-only, so deleting them directly runs into permission errors.
en.consequence: Cleared with a command; modules download again on the next build.

rules.title: Gradle 缓存
rules.explanation: Gradle 下载的依赖、构建缓存和旧版本的 Gradle 发行包。
rules.consequence: 下次构建时重新下载，第一次会比较慢。

en.title: Gradle cache
en.explanation: Dependencies, build caches and old Gradle distributions Gradle has downloaded.
en.consequence: Downloaded again on the next build, which will be slow the first time.

rules.title: Maven 本地仓库
rules.explanation: Maven 下载的所有依赖，也可能有你自己 install 进去的包。
rules.consequence: 下次构建时重新下载；自己 install 的包需要重新 install。

en.title: Maven local repository
en.explanation: Every dependency Maven has downloaded, and possibly packages you installed into it yourself.
en.consequence: Downloaded again on the next build; packages you installed yourself need installing again.

rules.title: Cargo 包缓存
rules.explanation: Rust crates 的下载包和解压后的源码。
rules.consequence: 下次构建时重新下载。

en.title: Cargo registry cache
en.explanation: Downloaded Rust crates and their unpacked sources.
en.consequence: Downloaded again on the next build.

rules.title: JetBrains IDE 缓存
rules.explanation: IntelliJ IDEA、PyCharm、GoLand 等的索引和缓存，包括已卸载旧版本留下的。
rules.consequence: 下次打开项目时重建索引。

en.title: JetBrains IDE caches
en.explanation: Indexes and caches of IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand and others, including those left by uninstalled versions.
en.consequence: Projects reindex the next time they open.

rules.title: VS Code 缓存
rules.explanation: VS Code 的界面缓存和扩展安装包缓存。
rules.consequence: 下次启动时重新生成。

en.title: VS Code caches
en.explanation: VS Code's interface cache and cached extension packages.
en.consequence: Rebuilt the next time it starts.

rules.title: Playwright / Puppeteer 浏览器
rules.explanation: 自动化测试下载的浏览器内核。
rules.consequence: 下次运行测试时重新下载（或执行 npx playwright install）。

en.title: Playwright / Puppeteer browsers
en.explanation: Browser engines downloaded for automated tests.
en.consequence: Downloaded again the next time tests run (or with npx playwright install).

rules.title: Electron 下载缓存
rules.explanation: 构建 Electron 应用时下载的运行时。
rules.consequence: 下次构建时重新下载。

en.title: Electron download cache
en.explanation: Runtimes downloaded while building Electron apps.
en.consequence: Downloaded again on the next build.

rules.title: Android 模拟器系统镜像
rules.explanation: Android SDK 下载的模拟器系统镜像，每个几 GB。
rules.consequence: 用到对应版本的模拟器时需要在 SDK Manager 里重新下载。

en.title: Android emulator system images
en.explanation: Emulator system images downloaded by the Android SDK, several GB each.
en.consequence: Download them again in the SDK Manager when an emulator needs that version.

rules.title: Docker 虚拟磁盘
rules.explanation: 所有镜像、容器和卷都在这个文件里，删除它等于清空 Docker。
rules.consequence: 用命令清理不再使用的镜像和容器，再在 Docker 设置里回收磁盘空间。

en.title: Docker virtual disk
en.explanation: Every image, container and volume lives in this file; deleting it empties Docker.
en.consequence: Removes unused images and containers with a command; then reclaim the disk space in Docker's settings.

rules.title: 应用日志
rules.explanation: 各个应用写下的运行日志和崩溃报告。
rules.consequence: 排查旧问题时会少一些线索，应用会继续写新的日志。

en.title: App logs
en.explanation: Logs and crash reports written by apps.
en.consequence: Fewer clues for investigating old problems; apps keep writing new logs.

rules.title: 废纸篓
rules.explanation: 移到废纸篓的文件仍然占用空间。
rules.consequence: 在 Finder 中清倒废纸篓后才会真正释放。

en.title: Trash
en.explanation: Files moved to the Trash still take up space.
en.consequence: Space is freed only after emptying the Trash in Finder.

rules.title: 下载文件夹里的安装包
rules.explanation: 装完应用后通常就用不到的 .dmg、.pkg 和 .xip。
rules.consequence: 需要重装时要重新下载。

en.title: Installers in Downloads
en.explanation: .dmg, .pkg and .xip files that are usually no longer needed once the app is installed.
en.consequence: Download them again if you need to reinstall.

rules.title: 动态壁纸视频
rules.explanation: 系统下载的航拍动态壁纸和屏幕保护视频。
rules.consequence: 再次选用这些壁纸时会重新下载。

en.title: Aerial wallpaper videos
en.explanation: Aerial wallpaper and screen saver videos the system downloaded.
en.consequence: Downloaded again when you choose those wallpapers.

rules.title: iPhone / iPad 备份
rules.explanation: 在 Finder 中备份的设备数据，每份往往有几十 GB。
rules.consequence: 删除后无法从这份备份恢复设备，建议只删已不再使用的设备的旧备份。

en.title: iPhone / iPad backups
en.explanation: Device backups made in Finder, often tens of GB each.
en.consequence: The device can no longer be restored from this backup; delete only old backups of devices you no longer use.

rules.title: iPhone / iPad 系统更新包
rules.explanation: 通过 Mac 给设备升级时下载的 .ipsw 固件。
rules.consequence: 下次通过 Mac 升级时重新下载。

en.title: iPhone / iPad software updates
en.explanation: .ipsw firmware downloaded when updating a device through the Mac.
en.consequence: Downloaded again the next time you update through the Mac.

rules.title: 邮件附件下载
rules.explanation: 在“邮件”里打开过的附件副本，原附件仍在邮件中。
rules.consequence: 再次打开附件时会重新生成。

en.title: Mail attachment downloads
en.explanation: Copies of attachments opened in Mail; the originals stay in the messages.
en.consequence: Recreated when the attachments are opened again.

rules.title: “信息”附件
rules.explanation: iMessage 中收发的照片、视频和文件。
rules.consequence: 对话里的这些附件将无法打开；开启了“iCloud 中的信息”时可在设置里改为自动删除旧信息。

en.title: Messages attachments
en.explanation: Photos, videos and files sent and received in iMessage.
en.consequence: These attachments can no longer be opened in conversations; with Messages in iCloud on, you can have old messages deleted automatically in Settings.

rules.title: 浏览器缓存
rules.explanation: Chrome、Edge、Firefox、Arc 缓存的网页资源。
rules.consequence: 网页第一次打开会慢一些，登录状态和书签不受影响。

en.title: Browser caches
en.explanation: Web content cached by Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Arc.
en.consequence: Pages load more slowly the first time; sign-ins and bookmarks are not affected.

rules.title: Slack、Discord 等应用缓存
rules.explanation: 基于 Electron 的桌面应用缓存的图片和网页资源。
rules.consequence: 应用第一次打开时会重新加载这些内容。

en.title: Slack, Discord and other app caches
en.explanation: Images and web content cached by Electron-based desktop apps.
en.consequence: The apps load this content again the first time they open.

rules.title: Spotify 缓存
rules.explanation: 播放时缓存的音乐数据，不包括下载到离线的歌曲。
rules.consequence: 听过的歌再次播放时重新缓冲。

en.title: Spotify cache
en.explanation: Music cached while playing, not songs downloaded for offline listening.
en.consequence: Songs you played buffer again.

rules.title: 微信聊天文件和视频
rules.explanation: 聊天中收发的文件、视频和图片，常年累积会占很大空间。
rules.consequence: 删除后在聊天里打开会提示文件已过期；需要保留的请先另存。

en.title: WeChat files and videos
en.explanation: Files, videos and images sent and received in chats; over the years they add up.
en.consequence: Opening them in chats says the file has expired; save anything you want to keep first.

rules.title: 微信缓存
rules.explanation: 微信缓存的头像、表情和小程序资源。
rules.consequence: 微信会按需重新下载。

en.title: WeChat cache
en.explanation: Avatars, stickers and mini program resources cached by WeChat.
en.consequence: WeChat downloads them again as needed.

rules.title: QQ 聊天图片、视频和文件
rules.explanation: QQ 聊天中收发的图片、视频和文件。
rules.consequence: 删除后在聊天里将无法查看这些内容；需要保留的请先另存。

en.title: QQ images, videos and files
en.explanation: Images, videos and files sent and received in QQ chats.
en.consequence: They can no longer be viewed in chats; save anything you want to keep first.

rules.title: QQ 缓存
rules.explanation: QQ 缓存的头像、表情和网页资源。
rules.consequence: QQ 会按需重新下载。

en.title: QQ cache
en.explanation: Avatars, stickers and web content cached by QQ.
en.consequence: QQ downloads them again as needed.

rules.title: 企业微信聊天文件
rules.explanation: 企业微信聊天中收发的文件、图片和视频。
rules.consequence: 删除后在聊天里需要重新下载，过期的文件将无法打开。

en.title: WeCom chat files
en.explanation: Files, images and videos sent and received in WeCom chats.
en.consequence: They need downloading again in chats, and expired files can no longer be opened.

rules.title: 企业微信缓存
rules.explanation: 企业微信缓存的网页和图片资源。
rules.consequence: 企业微信会按需重新下载。

en.title: WeCom cache
en.explanation: Web content and images cached by WeCom.
en.consequence: WeCom downloads them again as needed.

rules.title: 飞书缓存
rules.explanation: 飞书缓存的网页、图片和小程序资源。
rules.consequence: 飞书会按需重新下载。

en.title: Feishu (Lark) cache
en.explanation: Web content, images and mini program resources cached by Feishu.
en.consequence: Feishu downloads them again as needed.

rules.title: 钉钉缓存
rules.explanation: 钉钉缓存的图片和网页资源。
rules.consequence: 钉钉会按需重新下载。

en.title: DingTalk cache
en.explanation: Images and web content cached by DingTalk.
en.consequence: DingTalk downloads them again as needed.
